courseDetails.title: Language Learning with AI: Your Personal Language Partner
courseDetails.shortDescription: Learn any language faster with AI: conversations, stories at your level, quizzes and feedback, based on research
courseDetails.longDescription:
Imagine a language partner who's always available, never tired of your questions, never embarrassed by your mistakes, and happy to talk about football, cooking or whatever you love, at exactly your level. That's what an AI assistant can be. This course shows you how to use it that way, for any language, at any level.

You don't need any technical knowledge. If you can type a message on your phone, you can do everything in this course.

What you'll learn to do with AI:

  • Read at your level: stories written just for you using your own word list, news rewritten for your level, and photos of menus and signs turned into lessons.

  • Remember more: quizzes after every text, flashcards made in seconds, funny memory hooks, and grammar practice on exactly what you find hard.

  • Speak with confidence: role-plays at the market, rehearsals of real phone calls, voice conversations, adventure games and debates.

  • Write better: a daily diary with feedback that makes you think, real emails, false friends and idioms explained.

  • Build a system: a reusable 20-minute daily session, a weekly plan, motivation tips and honest progress checks.

  • Any language, any level: examples in Spanish, German, French and Portuguese, for absolute beginners and advanced learners.

Based on research. Every technique is built on what studies show about learning languages: testing yourself beats rereading, spacing your reviews, reading texts where you know almost every word, and feedback that makes you correct yourself. Recent reviews of dozens of studies also found that practising with chatbots helps learners. The AI makes all of this easy to do every day.

Real conversations. You follow one learner, Sam, preparing for a trip to Valencia, through 28 real conversations with Claude, shown exactly as they came back. You'll see what works brilliantly, like a story written so precisely for Sam that 97.6% of the words were already familiar, and the handful of small things worth double-checking.

All the prompts from the course are included as a download, ready to copy into the AI assistant you use, plus Sam's word list, the practice texts and audio for shadowing.

About 1 hour 35 minutes in 35 short lectures, each with a recap. Recorded October 2026.
targetAudiences: Anyone learning a new language who wants more practice, at their level, about things they enjoy
Travellers, expats and students preparing for a trip, a move or an exam
Beginners who feel shy about speaking, and advanced learners who want a challenge

courseDetails.title: AI Foundations for Professionals
courseDetails.shortDescription: Build practical AI knowledge, use generative AI tools effectively, and make informed decisions in the modern workplace.
courseDetails.longDescription:
This course contains the use of artificial intelligence.

AI Foundations for Professionals is a beginner-friendly course designed to help modern professionals understand, evaluate, and confidently use artificial intelligence in the workplace. You do not need programming experience, advanced mathematics, or a technical background. The course explains important AI concepts in clear, practical language and connects them to real-world business situations.

You will begin by learning what AI is and is not, along with the essential terminology needed to participate in conversations about artificial intelligence. You will explore machine learning, deep learning, algorithms, models, training data, and the major types of AI systems being used today.

The course then explains how AI works by examining the relationship between data, models, and training. You will understand the differences between supervised learning and unsupervised learning, as well as the fundamentals of large language models, generative AI, and modern AI assistants.

A major focus of the course is the practical use of AI in business. You will explore common applications across marketing, customer service, operations, finance, human resources, research, communication, and analytics. You will learn where AI can increase productivity, reduce repetitive work, support decision-making, and improve customer experiences. You will also examine situations where AI may not be the right solution.

The course provides an introduction to ChatGPT and similar AI tools, helping you understand how to communicate with AI assistants using effective prompts. Through practical examples, you will learn prompt engineering fundamentals, including how to provide context, define tasks, specify output formats, and improve weak AI responses. You will also see examples of AI task automation that can support everyday professional workflows.

Responsible use is essential when adopting artificial intelligence. This course covers AI privacy, cybersecurity, bias, hallucinations, data protection, human oversight, and governance. You will learn why AI-generated information must be reviewed and how organizations can reduce risks while still benefiting from innovation.

By the end of the course, you will have a strong foundation in artificial intelligence for professionals, generative AI, ChatGPT, business automation, and responsible AI. You will be better prepared to use AI tools productively, communicate with technical teams, evaluate business opportunities, and participate confidently in your organization’s AI transformation.

Whether you are a manager, entrepreneur, consultant, analyst, marketer, student, or business professional, this course will give you the practical AI literacy needed to succeed in an increasingly AI-powered workplace.

courseDetails.title: Motivation et Équilibre Émotionnel. Crée ta Journée Parfaite
courseDetails.shortDescription: Maîtrise le rééquilibrage émotionnel, crée ta journée parfaite, challenge-toi et vibre avec ta mission de vie
courseDetails.longDescription:
Tu te sens parfois démotivé après une journée difficile ? Tu aimerais retrouver cette énergie qui te donne envie de te lever le matin, avancer sur tes projets et profiter davantage de tes journées ?

Ce cours t’invite à travailler sur quatre dimensions essentielles : ta motivation, ton équilibre émotionnel, les challenges qui te stimulent et la manière dont tu construis tes journées.

L’objectif est simple : apprendre à mieux réagir aux moments difficiles et créer davantage de place pour les activités, les projets et les expériences qui te font réellement vibrer.

Rééquilibre tes journées

Une mauvaise journée au travail, une contrariété ou un moment stressant peut rapidement déborder sur tout le reste de ta journée.

Tu découvriras le principe du rééquilibrage émotionnel par l’activité : après une période difficile, créer volontairement un moment positif qui te permet de changer de dynamique.

Restaurant, cinéma, massage, promenade, sport, activité créative, moment avec tes proches… tu apprendras à identifier les activités qui fonctionnent pour toi et à leur faire une vraie place dans ton quotidien.

L’objectif n’est pas de nier les émotions difficiles, mais de ne pas leur laisser automatiquement toute la journée.

Challenge-toi pour retrouver ta motivation

Nous avons parfois besoin d’un défi pour nous sentir pleinement engagés.

Tu apprendras à identifier et à créer des challenges intrinsèques : des défis que tu choisis parce qu’ils te stimulent personnellement, te donnent envie de progresser et apportent davantage d’intensité à ce que tu fais.

Tu réfléchiras également à ta mission de vie : non pas comme une réponse magique que tu dois absolument trouver, mais comme une direction qui peut t’aider à comprendre ce qui compte réellement pour toi et ce qui te donne envie d’avancer.

Utilise des déclencheurs de motivation

Parfois, une vidéo, un livre, une musique, une histoire ou une phrase suffit à provoquer un déclic.

Tu vas apprendre à identifier les contenus qui te stimulent réellement et à les utiliser consciemment lorsque tu as besoin de retrouver de l’élan.

Ces déclencheurs peuvent t’aider à sortir d’une période de passivité et à te poser une question essentielle :

« Qu’est-ce que je suis en train de faire, et qu’est-ce que j’ai réellement envie de faire maintenant ? »

L’objectif n’est pas de dépendre constamment d’une motivation extérieure, mais de savoir utiliser intelligemment ce qui peut réveiller ta propre envie d’agir.

Crée ta journée parfaite

À quoi ressemble une journée qui te fait vraiment plaisir ?

Dans cette partie, tu vas imaginer et construire ta journée parfaite en fonction de tes valeurs, de ton rythme, de tes priorités et de ce qui te procure réellement de l’énergie.

Travail, projets personnels, plaisir, repos, relations, challenges : tu vas réfléchir à la place que tu souhaites donner à chacun.

Ta journée parfaite n’est pas un planning rigide à reproduire exactement tous les jours. C’est plutôt une boussole qui t’aide à comprendre ce que tu aimerais retrouver plus souvent dans ta vie.

Prends du recul sur les pensées négatives

Certaines pensées méritent notre attention. D’autres tournent simplement en boucle et consomment notre énergie.

Tu apprendras à mieux les observer, à prendre de la distance et à éviter qu’une contrariété momentanée occupe tout ton espace mental.

Il ne s’agit pas de devenir positif en permanence. Une émotion difficile ou une pensée négative fait partie de la vie. L’objectif est plutôt de développer des moyens de retrouver progressivement ton équilibre et ton envie d’avancer.

Dans ce cours, tu vas notamment apprendre à :

  • Rééquilibrer une journée après un moment difficile.

  • Identifier les activités qui te font réellement du bien.

  • Créer des challenges personnels qui stimulent ta motivation.

  • Réfléchir à ta mission et à ce qui te fait vibrer.

  • Utiliser des déclencheurs pour retrouver de l’élan.

  • Construire ta propre version de la journée parfaite.

  • Prendre davantage de recul face aux pensées négatives.

  • Créer progressivement un quotidien plus proche de tes priorités.

Ce cours s’adresse à ceux qui souhaitent retrouver davantage de motivation, mieux traverser les journées difficiles et construire un quotidien plus stimulant et plus épanouissant.

Tu ne peux pas contrôler tout ce qui arrive dans une journée. Mais tu peux agir sur les challenges que tu choisis, les activités auxquelles tu accordes de la place et la manière dont tu retrouves ton équilibre après un moment difficile.

Ta journée parfaite n’est pas forcément une journée où tout se passe parfaitement. C’est une journée dans laquelle tu fais davantage de place à ce qui te fait vibrer.


Ce cours propose des outils de réflexion et des méthodes issus notamment de l’expérience personnelle de l’instructeur. Il ne garantit toutefois aucun résultat particulier et ne remplace pas un accompagnement médical ou psychologique. En cas d’anxiété, de détresse émotionnelle ou de difficultés persistantes, consulte un professionnel qualifié.
targetAudiences: Les professionnels démotivés qui veulent retrouver l'énergie et l'enthousiasme dans leur quotidien
Les personnes qui cherchent à rééquilibrer leur vie émotionnelle entre moments difficiles et expériences positives
Ceux qui veulent se connecter à leur mission de vie et vibrer à nouveau avec ce qu'ils réalisent
Les individus qui ont besoin de booster leur motivation et de générer une énergie instoppable
Toute personne désireuse de maîtriser ses émotions et créer sa journée idéale

courseDetails.title: Quantum Physics to Quantum Computing Masterclass
courseDetails.shortDescription: A beginner-friendly, step-by-step path from the basics of quantum physics to advanced quantum computing
courseDetails.longDescription:
This course contains the use of artificial intelligence.

Step into the fascinating world of quantum physics and learn how its revolutionary principles power the next generation of quantum computers. Quantum Physics to Quantum Computing Mastery is a beginner-friendly, step-by-step course designed to take you from the fundamentals of quantum mechanics to advanced quantum computing concepts, algorithms, hardware, and practical projects.

You do not need a background in physics or advanced mathematics to begin. The course introduces essential topics using clear explanations, visual intuition, practical examples, and hands-on programming exercises. You will first explore the foundations of quantum physics, including wave-particle duality, superposition, measurement, the uncertainty principle, quantum states, and entanglement.

Next, you will build the mathematical foundation required for quantum computing. You will learn algebra, vectors, matrices, complex numbers, probability, statistics, and linear algebra in an approachable way. These concepts will help you understand how qubits, quantum gates, state vectors, and quantum circuits work.

The course then introduces the fundamentals of quantum information science, including bits versus qubits, the Bloch sphere, single-qubit operations, multi-qubit systems, quantum gates, and circuit design. You will discover how quantum computers differ from classical computers and explore important applications in cryptography, optimization, scientific simulation, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Using Python for quantum computing and Qiskit, you will create quantum circuits, run simulations, interpret measurement results, and debug quantum programs. You will also study popular quantum algorithms, including the Deutsch algorithm, Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm, Grover’s search algorithm, and Shor’s algorithm. The course explains quantum speedup and helps you understand when quantum algorithms can provide meaningful advantages.

As you progress, you will explore intermediate and advanced topics such as tensor products, Bell states, quantum teleportation, quantum cryptography, variational quantum algorithms, the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm, quantum machine learning, noise models, and quantum error mitigation.

You will also gain a practical understanding of quantum error correction, decoherence, logical qubits, physical qubits, fault-tolerant quantum computing, and the challenges involved in scaling quantum systems.

The hardware section examines leading quantum technologies, including superconducting qubits, ion traps, photonic quantum computing, and neutral-atom systems. You will compare their strengths, limitations, and potential roles in the future of quantum technology.

Hands-on quantum computing projects include building a quantum random number generator, creating Bell states, implementing Grover’s algorithm, simulating quantum circuits, and exploring quantum encryption. You will complete a capstone project that demonstrates your growing quantum computing skills.

By the end of the course, you will have a strong foundation in quantum mechanics, quantum programming, Qiskit, quantum algorithms, quantum hardware, and quantum information science. You will also learn about quantum computing careers, research pathways, portfolio development, interview preparation, and opportunities for continued learning.

Whether you are a student, developer, engineer, researcher, technology professional, or curious beginner, this course provides a structured path toward mastering one of the most exciting and transformative technologies of the future.

courseDetails.title: Regolamento UE sull'IA (AI Act) 2026: corso pratico
courseDetails.shortDescription: Aggiornato all'Omnibus digitale (Regolamento (UE) 2026/1744): classificare, documentare, dimostrare e pianificare
courseDetails.longDescription:
In questo corso vengono utilizzati strumenti di intelligenza artificiale.

Il regolamento europeo sull'intelligenza artificiale (AI Act), il Regolamento (UE) 2024/1689, è la normativa sull'IA più rilevante al mondo, e il 2026 è l'anno in cui smette di essere teoria per la vostra organizzazione. Le pratiche vietate sono già sanzionabili. Gli obblighi per i modelli di IA per finalità generali si applicano da agosto 2025. L'Omnibus digitale — Regolamento (UE) 2026/1744, in vigore dal 27 luglio 2026 — ha rinviato gli obblighi per i sistemi ad alto rischio dell'allegato III al 2 dicembre 2027 (sistemi dell'allegato I: 2 agosto 2028). Sembra un orizzonte lungo, finché non ci si accorge che valutazioni della conformità, documentazione tecnica dell'allegato IV, valutazioni d'impatto sui diritti fondamentali e fascicoli delle evidenze tra fornitore e deployer vanno costruiti ben prima della scadenza.

Questo corso è la cassetta degli attrezzi di chi applica il regolamento. Non è un trattato giuridico né una preparazione a un esame: è il quaderno di lavoro che vi serve per mettere in pratica il regolamento già dal lunedì mattina. Percorriamo ogni capo del regolamento con la profondità che serve nella pratica, dalle definizioni dell'articolo 3 alle sanzioni dell'articolo 99, comprese le modifiche dell'Omnibus digitale. Imparerete a classificare qualsiasi sistema di IA alla luce dell'articolo 6 e dell'allegato III, a costruire la documentazione tecnica dell'allegato IV, a delimitare e svolgere una valutazione d'impatto sui diritti fondamentali e a pianificare una roadmap di 18 mesi che il vostro consiglio di amministrazione possa approvare.

Ancorato a un'azienda europea realistica. Ogni concetto, ogni esempio e ogni esercitazione si svolge in Lumora HR, un'azienda di tecnologie per la selezione del personale con sede a Berlino che è al tempo stesso fornitore di un sistema di preselezione ad alto rischio, deployer di strumenti di IA interni e fornitore a valle che lavora su un modello di IA per finalità generali. Alla fine della parte 7 avrete accompagnato Lumora da una crisi — la richiesta di evidenze di un cliente — fino a una roadmap di conformità pronta per il consiglio. È questo filo conduttore unico a far restare in mente i contenuti.

Che cosa saprete fare alla fine del corso:

Gratitude, the attitude that sometimes seem counter-intuitive, especially when we look around and find no reason to engage in it.

It is defined as the quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation for and to return kindness.

Beyond that, it is a quality or trait that you can express by reflection, self and for the people, things and circumstances around you.

It has a few powerful side effects. Some include:

- A change in perspective

- Uplifting ones mood

- Creating a suitable environment, at least within ones mind, that facilitates good decision making   


Gratitude for what, many ask?

Gratitude for Health, Sleep, Food, Body, Mind, Wellbeing, Peace of Mind, Finances, a job, career, income, roof over ones head, ability to earn, appreciate the way the world works and make a living out of it.

Gratitude for interactions, relationships with those around us, our families, children, parents, friends, colleagues, associates.

Gratitude for our professional situations, abilities, opportunities, overcoming challenges and much more.


To build this perspective into ones life is a gift one should bestow on ones self. It helps open up new perspectives at all times.

It also has immense benefits for your health - mentally, physically, emotionally. IT helps with better sleep, better self esteem, improved moods and much more.


The opportunities we have in this one life will be amplified and optimised by a quality such as Gratitude in our lives.


Gratitude to people also help forge better relations. It does not mean we should cease to have our own minds or always defer to what the people we are grateful to want, but it should be demonstrated genuinely, from the heart at every deserving opportunity. It is a privilege to have others support, care and help us.

We ourselves would do well to seek out people to support, care for and help. Not in search of gratitude or having them in our debt, but to show how grateful we are for the things that have come our way, without expecting anything from anyone in return.


Lastly, Gratitude to who?


Whoever you decide or However or Whatever you decide to show Gratitude to in your own way.


Thanks for stopping over on this course and I hope it will contribute to your life in some way.


I am grateful for the privilege to be able to reach you.


Please, remember to reach out and or leave a feedback.


Best regards,

Baba

Bu kurs, yapay zekâ kullanımını içermektedir.

AB Yapay Zekâ Yasası (AI Act), yani (AB) 2024/1689 sayılı Tüzük, dünyanın en kapsamlı sonuçlar doğuran yapay zekâ düzenlemesidir ve 2026, kuruluşunuz için teorinin geride kaldığı yıldır. Dijital Omnibus, yani 27 Temmuz 2026'dan beri yürürlükte olan (AB) 2026/1744 sayılı Tüzük, Ek III kapsamındaki yüksek riskli sistemlere ilişkin yükümlülükleri 2 Aralık 2027 tarihine erteledi (Ek I sistemleri: 2 Ağustos 2028). Bu uzun bir hazırlık süresi gibi görünür; ta ki uygunluk değerlendirmelerinin, Ek IV teknik dosyalarının, temel haklar etki değerlendirmelerinin ve sağlayıcı ile uygulayıcı arasındaki kanıt dosyalarının son tarihten çok önce hazırlanması gerektiğini fark edene kadar.

Tüzük'ün her bölümünü, Md. 3'teki tanımlardan Md. 99'daki yaptırımlara ve Dijital Omnibus değişikliklerine kadar uygulamada gereken derinlikte ele alıyoruz. Her yapay zekâ sistemini Md. 6 ve Ek III'e göre sınıflandırmayı, Ek IV teknik dosyasını hazırlamayı, temel haklar etki değerlendirmesinin kapsamını belirleyip yürütmeyi ve yönetim kurulunuzun onaylayacağı 18 aylık bir yol haritası planlamayı öğreneceksiniz.

Gerçekçi tek bir Avrupa şirketi üzerine kurulu. Her kavram, her örnek ve her ödev, merkezi Berlin'de bulunan bir işe alım teknolojisi şirketi olan Lumora HR'da geçer. Kimler için:

Gereksinimler:

  • Kurs boyunca kullanılan, indirilebilir 23 Türkçe Word şablonu: yapay zekâ sistemleri envanteri, sınıflandırma karar ağacı, Ek IV teknik dosya taslağı, FRIA formu, Md. 50 bilgilendirme metinleri kütüphanesi, tedarikçi anketi, AB uygunluk beyanı, ciddi olay bildirim el kitabı, ISO 42001 eşleştirmesi ve daha fazlası

Ekim 2026 itibarıyla hukuki durum, Dijital Omnibus ((AB) 2026/1744 sayılı Tüzük) dâhil; Lumora vaka çalışması Mayıs 2026'da geçer. Tüzük ve Yapay Zekâ Ofisi'nin kılavuz ilkeleri değişmeye devam ediyor. courseDetails.longDescription:
Este curso contém o uso de inteligência artificial.

O Regulamento da Inteligência Artificial da União Europeia (AI Act), o Regulamento (UE) 2024/1689, é a regulação de IA de maior impacto no mundo, e 2026 é o ano em que ele deixa de ser teoria para a sua organização. As práticas proibidas já podem ser punidas. As obrigações dos modelos de IA de finalidade geral se aplicam desde agosto de 2025. O Omnibus Digital — Regulamento (UE) 2026/1744, em vigor desde 27 de julho de 2026 — adiou as obrigações dos sistemas de risco elevado do anexo III para 2 de dezembro de 2027 (sistemas do anexo I: 2 de agosto de 2028). Parece um prazo longo, até você perceber que as avaliações da conformidade, a documentação técnica do anexo IV, as avaliações de impacto sobre os direitos fundamentais e os pacotes de evidências entre prestador e responsável pela implantação precisam estar prontos bem antes do prazo.

Este curso é uma caixa de ferramentas para quem aplica o regulamento. Não é um tratado jurídico nem uma preparação para exame: é o caderno de trabalho de que você precisa para colocar o regulamento em prática já na segunda-feira de manhã. Percorremos cada capítulo do regulamento com a profundidade que a prática exige, das definições do artigo 3 às sanções do artigo 99, incluindo as alterações do Omnibus Digital. Você vai aprender a classificar qualquer sistema de IA à luz do artigo 6 e do anexo III, a montar a documentação técnica do anexo IV, a delimitar e conduzir uma avaliação de impacto sobre os direitos fundamentais e a planejar um roteiro de 18 meses que o seu conselho de administração possa aprovar.

Ancorado numa empresa europeia realista. Cada conceito, cada exemplo e cada exercício acontece na Lumora HR, uma empresa de tecnologia de recrutamento com sede em Berlim que é ao mesmo tempo prestador de um sistema de pré-seleção de risco elevado, responsável pela implantação de ferramentas internas de IA e prestador a jusante que trabalha sobre um modelo de IA de finalidade geral. Ao final da parte 7, você terá acompanhado a Lumora desde uma crise — o pedido de evidências de um cliente — até um roteiro de conformidade pronto para o conselho. Esse fio condutor único é o que faz o conteúdo ficar na memória.

O que você vai saber fazer ao final do curso:

  • Classificar qualquer sistema de IA à luz do artigo 6, do anexo I e do anexo III, e aplicar o teste de derrogação do artigo 6(3)
  • Montar a documentação técnica do anexo IV, as instruções de utilização do artigo 13 e o pacote de evidências do responsável pela implantação do artigo 26
  • Delimitar e conduzir uma avaliação de impacto sobre os direitos fundamentais (AIDF) nos termos do artigo 27, e conciliá-la com uma AIPD do GDPR
  • Montar um roteiro de conformidade de 18 meses alinhado ao calendário do Omnibus Digital
  • Entender o Código de Práticas para a IA de Finalidade Geral e obter as evidências certas dos fornecedores dos seus modelos
  • Apresentar ao conselho de administração a exposição a sanções nos três níveis do artigo 99

Para quem é:

  • Profissionais de conformidade e líderes de governança de IA que estão estruturando um programa de adequação
  • Encarregados de proteção de dados (DPO) que estão ampliando sua atuação para os riscos de IA
  • Auditores internos responsáveis pelos controles de IA
  • Gestores de riscos que estão construindo uma taxonomia de riscos de IA
  • Consultores de GRC que assessoram clientes europeus

Pré-requisitos:

  • Conhecimento prático do GDPR, o regulamento geral de proteção de dados da União Europeia (supomos que você sabe o que é uma AIPD e o que faz o artigo 6 do GDPR)
  • Noções de sistemas de gestão (experiência com ISO 27001 ou ISO 9001 ajuda, mas não é necessária)
  • Curiosidade sobre IA, mas nenhuma formação técnica em aprendizado de máquina é necessária

O que o curso inclui:

  • 33 videoaulas em 7 partes: mais de quatro horas de vídeo, com foco na prática
  • 7 questionários, com 50 perguntas no total, um ao final de cada parte
  • 5 exercícios com soluções completas (memorando de classificação, sumário da documentação do anexo IV, delimitação de uma AIDF, procedimento para incidentes graves, matriz de evidências dos fornecedores GPAI)
  • Um projeto final: o roteiro de conformidade de 18 meses apresentado ao conselho de administração
  • 23 modelos Word para baixar, citados ao longo do curso, entre eles: inventário de sistemas de IA, árvore de decisão de classificação, estrutura do anexo IV, formulário de AIDF, biblioteca de avisos de transparência (artigo 50), questionário ao fornecedor, declaração UE de conformidade, procedimento de comunicação de incidentes graves e correspondência com a ISO 42001. Modelos, aulas, questionários e exercícios estão em português.

Situação jurídica de outubro de 2026, incluindo o Omnibus Digital (Regulamento (UE) 2026/1744); o estudo de caso da Lumora se passa em maio de 2026. O regulamento e as orientações do Serviço para a IA continuam evoluindo. Em cada aula, sinalizamos o que reflete a situação numa data específica, para que você saiba o que verificar de novo antes de entregar seus documentos a um organismo notificado ou a um auditor. Step into the future of technology with 100 Days of Quantum Computing Coding, a practical, project-based course designed to take you from complete beginner to confident quantum computing developer. Through 100 days of structured lessons, coding exercises, quantum circuits, algorithms, simulations, and real-world projects, you will develop the skills needed to understand and build quantum applications.

This course makes quantum computing for beginners approachable by combining essential theory with hands-on coding. You will begin by setting up your quantum development environment, refreshing the Python skills needed for quantum programming, and writing your first quantum program. You will then explore foundational concepts such as qubits, quantum states, vectors, basis states, superposition, measurement, probability amplitudes, and circuit visualization.

As you progress, you will learn how important quantum gates such as the X, Z, H, S, T, rotation, and controlled gates transform quantum states. You will build and analyze single-qubit and multi-qubit circuits while gaining practical experience with entanglement, Bell states, tensor products, CNOT gates, quantum correlations, and measurement outcomes.

The course also introduces the design and organization of complete quantum circuits. You will learn how to create reusable circuit blocks, parameterized circuits, modular workflows, and efficient quantum logic patterns. You will practice debugging circuits, comparing outputs, analyzing circuit depth, and improving the structure of your quantum programs.

A major part of the course focuses on quantum algorithms. You will implement and explore the Deutsch algorithm, Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm, Grover’s search algorithm, oracle design, quantum phase estimation, and other important computational techniques. You will compare quantum approaches with classical methods and build an intuitive understanding of when quantum algorithms may provide an advantage.

You will also explore advanced topics including quantum teleportation, superdense coding, variational quantum circuits, parameter optimization, quantum machine learning, circuit ansatz design, and hybrid quantum-classical workflows. These lessons will show you how quantum processors and classical computers can work together to solve complex problems.

Because real quantum computers are affected by noise, you will study quantum error handling, decoherence, relaxation, readout errors, noise models, error mitigation, and noise-aware circuit design. You will compare simulator results with real quantum hardware and learn how to evaluate circuit reliability using shot counts, histograms, and experimental data.

Later in the course, you will access real quantum hardware, select suitable backends, manage execution queues, understand hardware limitations, and run quantum circuits on real devices. You will also explore practical applications in quantum cryptography, optimization, quantum chemistry, random number generation, and emerging quantum technologies.

Every ten days, you will complete a practical mini project, including a quantum coin flip, gate playground, quantum random number generator, Bell state simulator, quantum logic lab, Grover search challenge, hybrid quantum model, noisy circuit study, and real-device experiment.

The final ten days guide you through building a complete quantum computing capstone project. You will choose a use case, design the circuit workflow, build and test the solution, create visualizations, document your findings, and package the project for your professional portfolio.

By the end of this course, you will have completed 100 days of quantum coding, built multiple hands-on projects, worked with simulators and real quantum devices, and created a portfolio demonstrating practical skills in Python quantum programming, quantum circuits, algorithms, hardware, and real-world quantum application development.

courseDetails.title: KI-nativer SDLC mit Claude Code: planen, bauen, prüfen
courseDetails.shortDescription: Bauen Sie Ihren Softwarelebenszyklus für agentische KI um – mit Gates, Evals und Audit-Nachweisen, die halten.
courseDetails.longDescription:
Dieser Kurs wurde unter Zuhilfenahme von künstlicher Intelligenz erstellt.

Etwa acht Wochen, nachdem eine Engineering-Organisation agentisches Programmieren für alle freigegeben hat, passiert etwas ganz Bestimmtes. Das Volumen gemergter Pull Requests verdoppelt sich ungefähr. Alle feiern. Und dann kommt die zweite Zahl: Die mediane Review-Zeit steigt, die Change-Failure-Rate klettert, und ein Quartal später fragt jemand in einem Audit, wer die Änderung freigegeben hat, die ein Agent um zwei Uhr nachts geschrieben hat — und niemand kann es beantworten.

Das ist kein KI-Problem. Es ist ein Prozessproblem. Wir sind sehr gut darin geworden, KI Code schreiben zu lassen, und haben jede Phase rund um den Code im menschlichen Tempo weiterlaufen lassen.

Dieser Kurs baut den Lebenszyklus selbst um. Er folgt dem AI-Native SDLC Playbook von Anthropic — sechs Phasen, angeordnet als Kreislauf statt als Linie: Jede Phase endet mit dem Commit eines Artefakts, und die nächste beginnt damit, es zu lesen. Sie bauen die ganze Kette: eine Absichtsdatei, eine Spezifikation, einen Plan, den Diff mit seinen Tests, den Pull Request mit seinen Review-Befunden und den Vorfallsbericht, der die nächste Absicht schreibt.

Jeder Mechanismus wird gebaut, nicht nur beschrieben. Sie schreiben einen PreToolUse-Hook, der eine Bearbeitung blockiert und den Freigabeweg nennt. Sie befragen Claude zu einem Plan, bevor eine Zeile Code existiert. Sie richten eine Eval-Suite ein, die die Konfiguration Ihres Agenten per Regressionstest prüft, wenn sich ein Skill ändert. Sie schreiben eine Review-Richtlinie mit Schweregrad-Schwelle und Nit-Obergrenze. Sie setzen ein Produktions-Gate, bis zu dem der Agent handeln darf und das er nicht passieren kann. Und Sie richten statistische Kontrollgrenzen ein, sodass eine Grenzverletzung bei drei Sigma sich selbst diagnostiziert und eine Absichtsdatei anlegt, bevor jemand alarmiert wird.

Governance ist ein vollwertiges Anliegen, kein Nachgedanke. Jedes Play in diesem Kurs benennt, was durchgesetzt wird, was der Nachweis ist, wo er protokolliert wird und wer freigibt. Sie lernen den teuersten Designfehler, den Teams machen — die falsche Stärke einer Kontrolle zu wählen — und den Unterschied zwischen einer Regel, die hält, und einem Satz in einer Datei, den niemand durchsetzt.

Wir arbeiten durchgehend mit einem Unternehmen. Meridian Pay ist eine B2B-Zahlungsplattform mit 640 Mitarbeitenden: von der britischen Finanzaufsicht FCA zugelassen, mit seiner EU-Gesellschaft im Anwendungsbereich von DORA, PCI DSS auf dem Karteninhaberpfad, SOC 2 und ISO 27001. Das Unternehmen hat Claude Code an 90 Engineers ausgerollt, sein PR-Volumen verdoppelt, die Change-Failure-Rate von 8 % auf 19 % steigen sehen und ein internes Audit nicht bestanden, weil es nicht nachweisen konnte, wer agentenerstellte Änderungen im PCI-Scope freigegeben hatte. Der CTO hat ein Quartal, um das zu beheben, ohne das Tempo wieder abzugeben. Jede Entscheidung in diesem Kurs wird unter dieser Vorgabe getroffen.

Sie gehen mit Artefakten nach Hause, nicht mit Notizen. Vorlagen für Absicht, Spezifikation, Plan und Review. Ein Hook für geschützte Pfade und ein Produktions-Gate-Hook. Ein Einstieg in eine Eval-Suite. Eine Konfiguration für Kontrollgrenzen. Ein Paket aus Früh- und Spätindikatoren mit einem Schritt zur Erfassung der Baseline. Ein Arbeitsblatt, das jedes Gate NIST SSDF, ISO/IEC 42001 und SOC 2 zuordnet. Und einen 90-Tage-Rollout-Plan, den Sie am Montag vor Ihrer Leitung vertreten können.

Fünfunddreißig Lektionen, acht Kapitel, fünf Aufgaben und eine abschließende Übungsprüfung. Für Engineering Leads, Plattform-Teams und alle, die für das Tempo und die Nachweise verantwortlich sind.
